dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge defines a deep concave spline from the posterior insertion point, interrupted by a significant semi-circular indentation approximately 10-15% distal to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Small-radius rounded apex characterized by a posterior-facing hook-like truncation.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 35-40 degree linear incline relative to the horizontal dorsal midline.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.8:1 ratio of the visible base chord length to the vertical height from base to apex.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinctive deep notch on the upper trailing edge. Multiple high-contrast white punctate marks/spots distributed across the lateral flank and fin. A subtle dark vertical linear mark is visible on the flank below the leading edge of the dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique irregular 'jagged' profile of the uppermost trailing edge immediately below the apex.
